title: ITE WSDip
line: One system for students, teachers and companies.
problem: ITE's work-study programme has four kinds of users, and each needs to see different information from the same system.
did: During my internship I built screens for each type of user, connected them to the data behind the scenes and fixed problems as they came up. I also helped put new versions live.
outcome: A more reliable system for everyone who uses it, from students to partner companies.

story.title: The challenge
story.body:
ITE's Work-Study Diploma connects students, their teachers and the companies they train with. Four kinds of users share one system, and each needs to see different information.

Keeping it clear and reliable for all of them is the hard part.

story.title: What I did
story.body: During my internship at Amber Creative, I built screens for each type of user and connected them to the data behind the scenes. I fixed problems as they came up, and helped put new versions of the platform live.

image.alt: The ITE Work-Study Diploma sign-in page

story.title: The tools
story.body: The platform is built with Next.js, React and TypeScript, using shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS for the interface, with Zustand, Azure Blob Storage, Docker, Node.js and Swagger UI behind the scenes.

story.title: The result
story.body: A more reliable system for everyone who uses it, from students to partner companies.
